headline: High: aci can exfiltrate CRM/email data via broad egress while the zoomcamp side adds no compensating controls; prompt-injection and compliance risks are otherwise limited by the course’s non-runnable profile.

A_prompt_injection.rationale: aci can ingest external content through APIs/MCP and has broad integration surfaces, so prompt injection is plausible if attacker-controlled text reaches it. data-engineering-zoomcamp is not runnable and exposes no I/O surfaces, so there is no documented direct bridge from B back into A. The pathway exists only through unusual manual transfer or external tooling.
conditions: IF operator manually copies B-produced text into aci prompts or MCP inputs
IF an external system forwards untrusted content from B into aci without sanitization
mitigations: Disable copy-paste of untrusted course text into aci prompts
Add a short provenance note before any pasted content
Use a fixed prompt template that separates instructions from content
requires-engineering: add content provenance tagging in the orchestrator

B_data_leakage.rationale: aci touches CRM, email, calendar, and support data and has broad network egress, so sensitive data could leave its environment. data-engineering-zoomcamp touches no data classes and has no I/O surfaces, so it does not add leakage risk itself. The pair risk is driven by aci’s default external connectivity rather than a documented B-to-A data path.
conditions: IF aci is connected to live CRM or email accounts containing sensitive records
IF aci is allowed to send retrieved content to third-party APIs
mitigations: Restrict aci to a test tenant
Remove or disable nonessential API connectors
Review outbound destinations for CRM/email payloads
Mask sensitive fields before any external call
requires-engineering: enforce egress allowlists

C_capability_conflict.rationale: aci supports multiple instances and can call mutable external services, but the zoomcamp profile is not runnable and exposes no write surfaces. That makes direct write-write conflict unlikely. Any conflict would require extra orchestration not shown in either profile, so the pairwise overlap is limited.
conditions: IF an external orchestrator gives both agents write access to the same CRM, sheet, or workspace
IF aci instances are pointed at the same mutable backend without locking
mitigations: Assign separate workspaces or tenants
Run only one aci instance per mutable resource
Add a manual lock before shared writes
requires-engineering: implement resource-level locking

D_cascading_error.rationale: aci can produce CRM, email, and calendar actions, so if its outputs are treated as authoritative they can cascade into downstream mistakes. data-engineering-zoomcamp is a non-runnable course, so it is not itself an action-taking verifier; however, the pair still has a plausible cascade if operators use B-derived material to configure A. Uncertainty pushes this to medium.
conditions: IF aci actions are triggered from unverified text copied from the course materials
IF downstream workflows trust aci-generated CRM/email content without review
mitigations: Require human review before sends or commits
Use a staging CRM account
Add a checklist for any generated outbound message
Log and diff all proposed actions before execution
requires-engineering: add verification gates

E_compliance.rationale: aci handles email, CRM, and support data and has broad egress, which can create residency or retention issues if deployed on regulated data. data-engineering-zoomcamp is a non-runnable course and does not itself process regulated data, so it is not the compliance driver. The risk is a mismatch between aci’s handling of sensitive business data and external services.
conditions: IF aci processes EU PII, customer support records, or CRM data under a residency policy
IF outbound integrations store or retain those records outside approved regions
mitigations: Confirm data-processing regions for each connector
Disable retention in connected SaaS tools where possible
Use synthetic data for testing
Document a deletion workflow for exported records
requires-engineering: add residency-aware routing
